title: Invertibility after scheme pullback
statement: If $f:X\to Y$ is a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] and $N$ is a natural number invertible in the global functions of Y, then N is invertible in the global functions of X. No positivity, Noetherian or nonempty hypothesis is needed.

source.place: Levelwise finite diagonal check, expanded in lem-sp-tower-p1-arbitrary-base-integrals

proof.text: Apply IsUnit.map to the global-sections ring homomorphism of f. Transport the result through map_natCast, which says the image of N is N.
